title: The Animals On The Farm
source: YouTube official English captions checked locally; Chinese translation added for HelloLILI

cues.en: The ducks on the farm say, "Quack, quack quack."
cues.zh: 农场里的鸭子说：“嘎，嘎，嘎。”

cues.en: The mice on the farm say, "Squeak, squeak, squeak."
cues.zh: 农场里的老鼠说：“吱，吱，吱。”

cues.en: The chickens on the farm say, "Cluck, cluck, cluck."
cues.zh: 农场里的小鸡说：“咯，咯，咯。”

cues.en: "Quack. Squeak. Cluck."
The pigs on the farm say, "Oink, oink, oink."
cues.zh: 农场里的小猪说：“哼，哼，哼。”

cues.en: The goats on the farm say "Meh, meh, meh."
cues.zh: 农场里的山羊说：“咩，咩，咩。”

cues.en: The sheep on the farm say "Baa, baa, baa."
cues.zh: 农场里的绵羊说：“咩，咩，咩。”

cues.en: "Oink. Meh. Baa."
The horses on the farm say, "Neigh, neigh, neigh."
cues.zh: 农场里的马说：“嘶，嘶，嘶。”

cues.en: The cows on the farm say, "Moo, moo, moo."
cues.zh: 农场里的奶牛说：“哞，哞，哞。”

cues.en: The roosters on the farm say, "Cock-a-doodle-doo."
cues.zh: 农场里的公鸡说：“喔喔喔。”

cues.en: "Neigh. Moo. Cock-a-doodle-doo."
